name: copywriting
tagline_zh:
主页、落地页、定价页……文案总差点意思？
让 AI 像资深营销人一样改写，专治“说不清卖点”的硬伤。
tagline_en: Rewrite your homepage, pricing, or landing page copy with a marketer's eye—fix vague value props, not just grammar.
desc_en: When the user wants to write, rewrite, or improve marketing copy for any page — including homepage, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, about pages, or product pages. why_zh: 它不套模板，而是按营销逻辑拆解每段文字，先定位问题再改，比通用改写更懂转化。
why_en: It diagnoses copy like a marketer, not a thesaurus—fixes positioning gaps, not just wording.
